persona: 31-year-old everyday buyer, likes understated graphic tees, film and design

designs.why: Calm, clean and clearly readable from 3 m: big lowercase 'the end' sits on the horizon, the half sun beside it and the little sailboat make a quiet film-ending feel. The ripple lines look like a real linocut, and the sun's glitter trail ties it together. I'd wear it and give it as a gift. Small drawbacks: the wide, dense sea fills a lot of the shirt and the top-left text feels slightly cramped by the edge, and the two gulls are tiny and a bit random.
designs.fix: Thin out or fade the lower sea lines so the print is lighter, less boxy and less heavy to wear, giving the text and sun more breathing room.
